findings.label: Approval-request workerId unset
findings.detail: Worker approval_request events never populate workerId because the shared approval gate is built in prepareRun before any worker exists and is not threaded the per-call worker id. Behaviour-safe (approvals still work) and documented in ci-task8.md; outside the Task 8.3 requirement set. Thread the id through the gate in a later task if the UI needs lane attribution. Non-blocking.

findings.label: v1 back-compat normalization untested
findings.detail: normaliseResult strips orchestration fields from v1/version-absent records (Requirement 12.3) but has no unit test and there is no execution-store.test.ts. Low production risk since real v1 records do not carry orchestration fields, but the back-compat guarantee is unverified by CI. Non-blocking.
